guard: the manager resolves connector harness binaries during boot, names unavailable connectors before any spawn, keeps unrelated connectors available, and records absolute resolved paths in status
why: Issue #965 reproduced through the built manager: start() completed silently with claude absent,
and only the first startAgent call returned the missing-harness error.
This smoke starts the real manager against an owned broker and asserts the diagnostic before
any spawn is attempted, so a spawn-only check cannot satisfy it.

mutations.name: manager boot stops inspecting connector harnesses
mutations.expectRed: manager boot surfaces the missing harness before any spawn is attempted
mutations.cell: manager boot surfaces the missing harness before any spawn is attempted

mutations.name: boot availability loses the resolved executable path
mutations.expectRed: boot records the resolved absolute harness path from a relative PATH entry
mutations.cell: boot records the resolved absolute harness path from a relative PATH entry

mutations.name: managed launches discard the boot-resolved binary map
mutations.expectRed: managed spawn uses the exact path resolved at boot
mutations.cell: managed spawn uses the exact path resolved at boot
